stabilityRule.text: A trial is stable iff (a) OK completions inside the window reach >= 98% of the offered rate, (b) errors + timeouts <= 0.5% of measured arrivals, (c) end-to-end p99 over all measured arrivals (timeouts at the timeout bound) < 1000 ms, and (d) the median OK latency of the last fifth of the window is <= 2x that of the first fifth, unless that last-fifth median is <= 20 ms.

stopRule.text: A curve stops after two consecutive majority-unstable rates, or after any rate whose mean achieved/offered ratio is below 0.5. Every rate that is run uses the full repetition count.
